create.title: Create dispatch request
create.drafts_tooltip: View and open drafts saved in this browser
create.clear_draft_tooltip: Delete the current draft (other drafts stay in the list)
create.step1_hint: Pick the right type so the next step shows the correct form (passengers / cargo).
create.step2_lead: Fill requester and dates first, then purpose and coordination.
create.search_name_hint: At least 2 characters. Pick a result to fill email, phone, unit.
create.proposed_date_title: Actual proposal date. Click to open calendar.
create.date_needed_title: Date and time the vehicle is needed; also used as outbound departure time in Details.
create.date_order_error: Vehicle date cannot be before proposal date.
create.urgent_title: On when faster handling is needed; explain why.

create.urgent_auto_banner: Marked Priority automatically: trip time is very soon (within {hours} hours per settings). Enter a reason below.
create.recurring_hint: Uses weekdays selected in the Details step (e.1 schedule). First departure uses the date/time you enter.
create.recurring_weekdays_empty: No weekdays yet — open the Details step to select days on the schedule.
create.replace_banner: Editing a reset draft — submitting updates this pending request.
create.basis_drop: Drag files here or click to choose
create.targets_hint: Pick at least one target to clarify internal allocation.
create.targets_warn: Select at least one target for clearer internal allocation.
create.coord_search_title: Same as section A: pick staff to fill name, email, phone.
create.coord_email_invalid: Enter a valid email or leave blank.
create.step4_lead: Review the summary below. When everything looks right, «{submit}». Use «{draft}» to save and continue later.
create.clear_modal_body: Removes this draft in the browser and resets the form. Other drafts stay. Cannot be undone.
create.library_hint: Stored in this browser for the current account (max 25). Pick one to continue or start new.
create.library_empty: No drafts yet. Use {action} to store one.

s3.title: 3. Trip details (request content)
s3.readonly_depart_hint: This time comes from “Vehicle needed on” in step {step}.
s3.trip_out_time_from_step2: Taken from Vehicle needed on in the previous step.
s3.guide_pass: Outbound departure time comes from step 2. Each schedule row must include return time and return drop-off (return after departure). Price, guest count, etc. can be added later.
s3.guide_cargo: Item name is required on at least one row. Pickup time comes from step 2; delivery time and delivery location are required. Other columns help dispatch estimate the vehicle.
s3.e1_meta: Each row is one leg or group. Use datetime pickers; enter clear addresses or point names for drivers.
s3.unit_price_title: Estimated unit price — type digits, dots auto
s3.extra_fee_title: Extra fees — type digits, dots auto
s3.multi_day_title: Check when the schedule spans multiple days
s3.e11_extralead: Vehicle use 3+ days — suggested form fee {amount}. Contact dispatch to confirm costs.
s3.to_after_from: Must be on or after «{from}» when both filled
s3.days_hint: May be empty — dispatch will confirm
s3.e2_meta: Clear times and places help routing. “Stop” for transfers; leave empty if direct.
s3.biz_unit_price_title: Unit price — type digits, dots auto
s3.biz_extra_fee_title: Extra fees — type digits, dots auto
s3.e21_lead_extra: Per form guidance; contact dispatch for cost details.
s3.e21_lead_default: Check if applicable; enter estimated cost (VND) or leave blank for dispatch.
s3.door_pickup_extra: (state pickup/drop addresses in table above — suggest {amount}/person)
s3.cargo_meta: One row per item or batch. Size/weight helps vehicle choice. Asterisk (*) columns are priority for SLA.
s3.cargo_name_title: Item name — required on at least one row
s3.card_hint_depart_optional: Leave empty if only return leg
s3.val_time_required: Enter outbound or return time for this row
s3.val_return_order: Return time must be after outbound time
